title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten under-21-safe Bronx outings with documented free admission, access, or programming for Fordham students and friends.

cards.entity_name: New York Botanical Garden Grounds Access
cards.title: Walk the Garden Grounds
cards.subtitle: A free Fordham-ID outing beside Rose Hill
cards.notes: Bring a valid Fordham ID to claim one Grounds Access Pass, then meet friends among the outdoor gardens and collections.
cards.short_summary: Turn a campus-adjacent garden walk into a no-ticket-cost group reset.
cards.evidence_claim: NYBG states that Fordham students receive one free Grounds Access Pass per visit with valid Fordham University ID.
cards.source_title: NYBG Community Access Programs | Discount Admission & Passes
cards.access_notes: Valid Fordham University ID required. The pass covers outdoor gardens and collections, not the conservatory, tram, or parking; availability applies.

cards.title: Browse Contemporary Art Together
cards.subtitle: Always-free galleries on the Grand Concourse
cards.notes: Check the exhibition calendar, enter through the open North Wing, and compare favorite works without buying admission.
cards.short_summary: A bilingual contemporary-art meetup with no admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum says admission to the museum and all exhibitions and events is always free for everyone; its North Wing remains open during renovation.
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday through Sunday, 11 a.m.–6 p.m.; check for exhibition changeovers and use the North Wing during construction.

cards.title: Take a Thursday Garden Walk
cards.subtitle: Free weekly access to Wave Hill's grounds
cards.notes: Go on Thursday, arrive at least 30 minutes before closing, and wander the gardens as a pair or small informal group.
cards.short_summary: A Thursday-only garden meetup overlooking the Hudson and Palisades.
cards.evidence_claim: Wave Hill's official visitor page states that admission is free all day Thursdays, except for organized groups.
cards.access_notes: Free all day Thursday for individual visitors and informal parties; the offer excludes organized groups and may not cover premium events.

cards.title: Reserve a Free Zoo Wednesday
cards.subtitle: Advance-reservation wildlife outing
cards.notes: Set a Monday reminder, reserve Wednesday Limited Admission together, and confirm which exhibits the ticket includes before arrival.
cards.short_summary: A reservation-based, no-admission-cost Wednesday zoo trip.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC's Department of Cultural Affairs lists free Wednesday Limited Admission at the Bronx Zoo and says advance reservations are required.
cards.source_title: Free and Suggested Admission - NYC Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: Reserve in advance for Wednesday Limited Admission. The zoo limits availability and may charge separately for premium exhibits or experiences.

cards.title: See Art at BronxArtSpace
cards.subtitle: A free-admission Bronx gallery stop
cards.notes: Check the gallery's current schedule, invite a classmate, and use the visit to trade observations about the work on display.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC's Department of Cultural Affairs lists BronxArtSpace among Bronx cultural organizations offering free admission.
cards.source_title: Free and Suggested Admission - NYC Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: Confirm the gallery's current exhibition dates and public hours before traveling; special programs may set separate terms.

cards.title: Meet Up Around a Group Exhibition
cards.subtitle: Free public gallery in the Fine Arts Building
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition, enter via the posted campus route, and choose one piece each to discuss before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A free CUNY gallery visit centered on thematic group shows.
cards.evidence_claim: Lehman College states that its Art Gallery is always free to the general public.
cards.access_notes: The gallery is in Lehman's Fine Arts Building. Verify the current exhibition schedule and campus-entry instructions before visiting.

cards.title: Compare Notes at Longwood Gallery
cards.subtitle: Free-admission visual art in the Bronx
cards.notes: Review the current show and public hours first, then bring a friend for a focused gallery visit that requires no ticket purchase.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost gallery conversation built around the current exhibition.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC's Department of Cultural Affairs lists Longwood Art Gallery as a Bronx cultural organization with free admission.
cards.source_title: Free and Suggested Admission - NYC Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current venue, exhibition dates, and opening hours directly with the gallery; separately ticketed programs may differ.

cards.title: Explore the Judaica Collection
cards.subtitle: A free museum visit at Hebrew Home
cards.notes: Confirm visitor procedures, then walk through the collection with a friend and pause to discuss one object that catches each person's eye.
cards.short_summary: A free collection-focused cultural outing in Riverdale.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC's Department of Cultural Affairs lists the Derfner Judaica Museum among Bronx institutions offering free admission.
cards.source_title: Free and Suggested Admission - NYC Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: Check current visitor requirements, hours, identification rules, and whether advance arrangements are needed before going.

cards.title: Read Outside on the Terrace
cards.subtitle: A free outdoor library space near Fordham
cards.notes: Bring your own reading, claim a terrace seat during library hours, and reconvene after a quiet chapter for conversation.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor reading hang at the Bronx's largest public library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bronx Library Center's official page identifies its third-floor General Collection and Reading Terrace as a free outdoor terrace.
cards.source_title: Bronx Library Center | The New York Public Library
cards.access_notes: Use during Bronx Library Center operating hours; center hours may vary, and weather or operational needs can affect terrace access.

cards.title: Plan a Library Work-and-Talk Session
cards.subtitle: Free resources and gathering space west of campus
cards.notes: Meet during branch hours, use the free Wi-Fi or public computers, and keep conversation at a level appropriate for the shared space.
cards.short_summary: A practical neighborhood-library hang for collaborative planning.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL lists Jerome Park Library as an open branch and states that its locations provide free computers and Wi-Fi, programs, and classes.
cards.access_notes: Visit during posted branch hours. Computer sessions may require a library card or reservation; Wi-Fi and entry require no purchase.

warnings: Bronx Zoo and Wave Hill free access is limited to specified days and conditions.
NYBG free Grounds Access is limited to eligible Fordham ID holders and excludes premium areas.
Gallery schedules and library terrace availability should be checked before departure.
